style: Refine every catalog object toward warm, softly lit cartoon art, consistent with the selected plant reference. Preserve identity, function and original palette family. Keep registered camera, dimensions, roots, sockets, ports, footprints and animation timing. No preferred horizontal light direction for rotatable world sprites; no directional ground shadows. Real 3D render output, editable Blender sources. The source 2D effects remain explicitly identified as 2D. Each object receives fresh independent editor/judge agents. Publish object-by-object to the same PR preview; integrate approved sprites into Godot after catalog review checks. Follow-on design exploration: improve the modeling itself, including forms, proportions, structure, crafted details and decorations. Original part counts and awkward geometry are not constraints. The editor may rebuild native geometry to achieve the better design; the judge should reward useful improvements. Preserve the locked registration, gameplay contact/clearance, animation and modular continuity contract. See modeling-policy.json version2.

qualityCriteria.basis: User warm softly lit cartoon direction, modelingPolicy version2, fixed target and independently inspected original native library. Outcome criteria only; the editor chooses native construction.

hardConstraints.outcome: Retain recorded35-degree character orthographic camera/projection, logical192x320 frame/root[96,248], native384x640 frame at sourceScale2, square pixels and source world/grid calibration. No silhouette fitting, crop expansion, per-facing camera offsets, target-image warping or final painted replacement.

Mateo remains the compact native chef: tan/light-amber skin, dark warm-brown fringe, RED folded bandana/headband with side tie, ivory coat, BLUE apron, RED necktie and dark footwear. Better face/hair/garment proportions are welcome within the functional contract; target hue drift is not authoritative.

Retain original one-cell occupied/support footprint, ground root, functional height1.3279640674591064 and source action clearance. Native form/proportion changes may use this body volume intelligently. Measure evaluated body geometry separately from functional props; retain original bob/pose behavior and original per-action envelope rather than fixing a static idle outline.

Preserve actual evaluated foot/hand/utensil/dish/belt-load attachment behavior and gameplay interaction alignment for every source pose/facing. Original prop reach can extend outside the body cell as in source. Use evaluated source geometry/rig/actions and projected dish attachment as references; stale custom socket values and the deliberately depth-biased 2D food plane must not drive false physical-contact fixes.

Deliver exactly all192 native frames: idle/work/hold/load x12 x N/E/S/W, with S0/E+90/N180/W-90 root rotations and original child facing retained. Preserve original source actions, frame order,12fps timing, atlas dimensions/rects (6columns x2rows,2304x1280 for each state/facing), idle/work/hold loop closure and nonlooping load policy. No invented walk or station.

Editable native Blender model and real native captures; pack/bind dependencies. Retain source dish-salmon as explicitly identified2D insert with original source image, composition, visibility and orientation behavior; do not invent modeled3D sushi or use a target-facing card for the character.

One consistent material/light setup for all rotations, with no preferred horizontal illumination direction, per-facing recoloring or directional ground cast shadow. Self-shading may describe form softly. Transparent background remains clean.

aestheticCriteria.success: Front, both profiles and rear read as one crafted cartoon chef with rounded, intentional head/hair/body/limb volumes, purposeful proportions and a stable stance. Hair locks flow around the skull; headband wraps and has readable folded fabric/side tie. Coat, sleeves, cuffs, apron and necktie show believable layered construction and finished contours. Reward useful native restructuring; do not preserve weak source boxes, old part counts or target details for their own sake.

Mateo retains the specified source palette family under soft warm light. Tan/light-amber face, brown hair, red cloth, ivory coat and blue apron stay clearly separated at logical192x320. Warmth does not bleach identity, turn blue to teal, merge reds/browns or make ivory dingy gray. Front/profile/rear colors remain consistent under rotation.

Broad soft gradients and restrained highlights explain cheeks, hair, hands, garment folds and apron edges; the face and eyes remain friendly/readable. Volume must improve visibly over source faceting without waxy glare, blown coat areas, flat emissive blocks or an overdark rear/underside. Match the target softness and warm family mood within the registered camera.

Hair/skin/cloth/apron/footwear have a coherent stylized finish, with material changes and purposeful garment details readable without clutter. Strong hierarchy carries silhouette first, garment layers second and a few useful folds/pocket/fastening details third. Seams, buttons, straps or stitches may differ from target or be omitted when too small; no mandatory embellishment inventory or implementation prescription.

At logical192x320 on light/gray/dark backgrounds, Mateo, red headwear/tie, blue apron, face, hands and action prop are readable without zoom. The modeled profile/back have intentional finished surfaces and coherent attachments; the single frontal target does not establish unseen outlines. Changes should be legible at game scale and remain structurally clean when enlarged.

No material black patches, muddy merged masses, jagged/open ends, coplanar flicker, exposed garment intersections, headband/hair/ear clipping, broken corners, harsh seams/normals, blown highlights, dirty transparency halos, stray pixels or unexplained cast shadow in any required frame/facing. Genuine source mechanics and intended self-occlusion are judged with their gameplay role in mind.

Every12fps state/facing playback remains smooth and source-consistent: stable face/hair/cloth structure, no collapsing wrists or sleeves, no changing topology/rest pops, no material/lighting shimmer, no attachment slip or sudden unwanted prop visibility, planted source feet and continuous original idle/work/hold loops. Load preserves its source nonlooping action and timing. Contacts must hold through all frames, not only selected stills.

requiredReviewEvidence: Hash-bound candidate packet for the exact editable .blend, dependencies,192 native frames,16 original-layout atlases, technical validation and all declared previews. No editor self-rating is evidence.
Four-view sheet, intended-size/enlarged views with light/gray/dark alpha backgrounds, verified all-frame sheets containing all192 frames, and actual12fps playbacks for all16 clip/facing combinations.

Native validation restoring recorded camera/root/frame; measured per-frame/facing root rotations; evaluated body bounds separately from prop reach; foot/hand/knife/dish/belt-load attachment comparison against source; action timing/loop coverage; topology/rest stability; dependency/material/light audit.
Registered gameplay interaction preview with neighboring serving belt and completed dish/customer scale sufficient to assess retained scale/reach/contact without changing capture.

Review directly inspects packet-bound pixels and all playback evidence. Missing visual or native contract evidence yields needs_evidence; visible material defects yield revise; approval requires visible improvement and passing frozen constraints, with no arbitrary numeric threshold.
qualityCriteria.targetDifferencesAllowed: No requirement to reproduce target framing, halo, noise, specific button/stitch count, exact source mesh count or unseen target geometry. Useful native design improvements are rewarded within locked identity/function/capture/animation constraints.
